About the product
  • THE COMPLETE 9-PIECE KIT: Includes a handmade 9" rattan banneton with linen liner, wooden bread lame with 5 steel blades, Danish dough whisk, dough scraper, digital kitchen scale, banneton manual and an artisan recipe booklet — everything you need from first mix to finished loaf.
  • ACCURATE DOUGH STARTS HERE: The stainless digital scale weighs to 1g precision with 5kg capacity and 6 units, so hydration and starter feedings come out right every time. Dual power: USB-C rechargeable or AAA batteries.
  • BETTER DOUGH, BETTER BREAD: Natural Indonesian rattan wicks moisture from the surface and supports the dough evenly during proofing — for a stronger rise and the classic spiral crust on artisan loaves.
  • PRECISE BREAD SCORING: The ergonomic wooden lame holds razor-sharp blades at the perfect angle for clean, decorative cuts. Adjustable screws, protective cover and 5 replacement blades included.
  • MIX & SHAPE WITHOUT MESS: The Danish dough whisk breaks up clumps for smooth, even dough, while the food-safe scraper handles, divides and shapes — clean cuts every time, easy to rinse off.
  • THE IDEAL GIFT FOR BAKING LOVERS: Arrives in an elegant gift-ready box with step-by-step manuals — perfect for beginners and seasoned sourdough bakers alike.
